description: This file defines functions for platform-specific upgrade and image check procedures for a device based on board type, specifically handling different behaviors for 'bananapi,bpi-rv2-nand' boards versus others.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a device upgrade by calling board-specific upgrade functions based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image against the device's board type, utilizing fit_check_image for generic checks.
